title: Taxonomy of Deceptive Reasoning Types in Thinking-Model CoT

original_idea.body: # Taxonomy of Deceptive Reasoning Types in Thinking-Model CoT. Hand-code then LLM-judge-tag CoT traces from open reasoning models binned by difficulty; test whether deception rate rises with task difficulty.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Taxonomy + difficulty-correlation directly informs how CoT monitors weight traces; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CoT collection + LLM-judge tagging with rubric; accessible, single GPU/API.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused taxonomy + hypothesis test; taxonomy design + human validation is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable CoT-monitoring infrastructure on open models; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on a reasoning model + LLM-judge, single GPU/API.

novelty.reasoning: Deception-type taxonomy + difficulty correlation flagged as a follow-up; plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Flagged as an open follow-up; angle plausibly open.
